cohort: 20 SARS-CoV-2 patients admitted between August 30th and October 30th, 2021 (Delta variant predominant) and 20 matched controls admitted between September 1st, 2020, and January 30th, 2021 (Alpha variant predominant).
finding: Patients infected with the Delta variant had more severe lung involvement on chest CT, lower PaO2/FiO2 ratio, and higher C-reactive protein and lactate dehydrogenase levels compared to those infected with the Alpha variant.
mod_finding: The consolidative pattern on chest CT was significantly associated with pregnancy.
